query: Tests, lint, and build are green. The current payment authorization tests only cover successful payments and assert that every payment is authorized without step-up authentication. A settled product decision now requires step-up authentication for payments above €500, but that test assertion still encodes the old rule. Run /system-health.
expected_behavior: Reports the automated results separately from qualitative test-depth findings
Flags TEST_SHALLOW because unauthorized and failure paths for the changed critical behavior are uncovered
Flags STALE_TESTS when existing tests encode an outdated payment contract, and names the evidence to confirm it
Does not convert green automation into an unqualified high-confidence health verdict
